item.title: 苹果发布 HomeView 家庭中枢，同步更新 Apple TV 与 HomePod mini
item.guid: 苹果发布-HomeView-家庭中枢，同步更新-Apple-TV-与-HomePod-mini
item.description:
Apple released new smart home products on October 13, including its first home hub HomeView, the fourth-generation Apple TV 4K, HomePod mini 2, and the Home Collection accessory series in collaboration with LG and Schneider Electric. 苹果 10 月 13 日发布智能家居新品，包括首款家庭中枢 HomeView、第四代 Apple TV 4K、HomePod mini 2，以及与 LG、施耐德电气合作的 Home Collection 配件系列。

  • HomeView: Features an A18 chip, Siri AI, and a 7-inch Liquid Retina display, offering both desktop and wall-mounted forms. It can recognize up to six family members, switching between their respective information, calendars, and other content, and supports FaceTime, music playback, and smart home control. Personal context features require an iPhone or iPad that supports Apple Intelligence. Both models are priced at $299 in the US and will be available on November 13. HomeView：搭载 A18 芯片、Siri AI 和 7 英寸 Liquid Retina 屏幕，提供桌面与壁挂两种形态，可识别最多六位家庭成员，切换各自的信息、日历等内容，并支持 FaceTime、音乐播放和智能家居控制。个人情境功能需搭配支持 Apple Intelligence 的 iPhone 或 iPad。两款美国售价均为 299 美元，11 月 13 日发售。
  • Apple TV 4K: Upgraded with an A19 chip, AV1 decoding, and three far-field microphones, supporting hands-free voice interaction; the new remote adds precise finding and sound localization. It can be paired with four compatible HomePod speakers to form a surround sound system, priced at $299 in the US, available on November 13. Apple TV 4K：升级 A19 芯片、AV1 解码和三枚远场麦克风，支持免遥控器语音交互；新遥控器增加精确查找与发声定位。可搭配四台匹配的 HomePod 扬声器组成环绕声系统，美国售价 299 美元，11 月 13 日发售。
  • HomePod mini 2: Features an S10 chip, adds Sound Glow lighting effects that change with music, and can serve as a Mac-compatible speaker. Available in five colors, priced at $149 in the US, available on October 30; Siri AI will be provided via a subsequent software update. HomePod mini 2：采用 S10 芯片，新增随音乐变化的 Sound Glow 灯效，并可作为兼容 Mac 的扬声器。提供五种配色，美国售价 149 美元，10 月 30 日发售；Siri AI 将通过后续软件更新提供。
  • Home Collection: Includes indoor and outdoor cameras, doorbells, door locks, thermostats, and temperature/humidity sensors. Accessories can be paired with a tap of an iPhone and managed uniformly within the "Home" app; supported camera recordings are stored end-to-end encrypted in iCloud+, without requiring a separate camera subscription. The series will be launched in phases starting in December, with some accessories available early next year. Home Collection：涵盖室内外摄像头、门铃、门锁、温控器及温湿度传感器。配件可通过 iPhone 轻触配对，在「家庭」App 内统一管理；支持的摄像头录像以端到端加密存入 iCloud+，无需另设摄像头订阅。系列从 12 月起陆续上市，部分配件于明年初发售。

Siri AI on HomeView and Apple TV will initially be a beta version, first offered in English to markets such as the US, UK, and Australia. Personal context invocation requires compatible devices; HomeView will not be sold in the EU initially. HomeView 与 Apple TV 上的 Siri AI 初期为测试版，首批以英语向美国、英国、澳大利亚等市场提供，个人情境调用需要兼容设备；HomeView 初期不在欧盟销售。

item.title: 国行 Apple Watch 上线睡眠呼吸暂停通知功能
item.guid: 国行-Apple-Watch-上线睡眠呼吸暂停通知功能
item.description:
Early this morning, Apple pushed out iOS 27.0.2 and watchOS 27.0.1 updates, and Apple Watch in mainland China officially supports sleep apnea notifications. Apple had already launched this feature in 2024, and in September this year, its "Mobile Sleep Apnea Indication Alert Software" received approval from the National Medical Products Administration. 今天凌晨，苹果推送 iOS 27.0.2 和 watchOS 27.0.1 更新，国行 Apple Watch 正式支持睡眠呼吸暂停通知。该功能苹果早在 2024 年就已推出，今年 9 月，其「移动睡眠呼吸暂停迹象提示软件」获得国家药监局批准。

Supported models include Apple Watch Series 9 and later, Apple Watch Ultra 2 and later, and Apple Watch SE 3. This feature is only available to users aged 18 and above who have not previously been diagnosed with sleep apnea. Users must first enable "Track Sleep with Apple Watch" and then complete the setup in the "Health" App. 支持机型包括 Apple Watch Series 9 及后续机型、Apple Watch Ultra 2 及后续机型，以及 Apple Watch SE 3。该功能仅面向年满 18 周岁、此前未被诊断患有睡眠呼吸暂停的用户，需先开启「通过 Apple Watch 跟踪睡眠」，再在「健康」App 中完成设置。

This feature captures subtle body movements during sleep via an accelerometer, and an algorithm identifies signs of respiratory disturbances. Users need to wear the watch to sleep for at least 10 nights within 30 days, and the system evaluates once every 30 days. 该功能通过加速度计捕捉睡眠时的细微身体运动，并由算法识别呼吸紊乱迹象。用户需在 30 天内至少佩戴手表入睡 10 个晚上，系统每 30 天评估一次。

If at least half of the effective monitoring nights are determined to have "increased respiratory disturbances," users may receive notifications of moderate to severe sleep apnea signs and can export a PDF health report for doctor's reference. This feature is not a real-time alarm and will not wake the user when symptoms occur. 若至少一半的有效监测夜晚被判定为「呼吸紊乱上升」，就可能收到中度至重度睡眠呼吸暂停迹象通知，并可导出 PDF 健康报告供医生参考。该功能并非实时报警，也不会在症状发生时唤醒用户。

According to statistics, over 1 billion people worldwide suffer from sleep apnea, with nearly 80% remaining undiagnosed. 据统计，全球超过 10 亿人患有睡眠呼吸暂停，其中近 80% 尚未确诊。

item.title: Gemini 4 Argon 正式发布
item.guid: Gemini-4-Argon-正式发布
item.description:
Google today released its new flagship model, Gemini 4 Argon, making it available to developers, enterprises, and subscribers, with a focus on complex multi-step tasks in coding, finance, law, cybersecurity, and scientific research. Google 今日发布新旗舰模型 Gemini 4 Argon，向开发者、企业及订阅用户开放，重点面向编码、金融、法律、网络安全和科学研究中的复杂多步任务。

Argon offers paid calls via the Gemini API on development platforms like AI Studio, with an introductory price of $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, and cached input prices reduced by 95%. The API provides a unified input/output quota of 1 million tokens, which can be used with a new task continuation protocol to handle long tasks. Argon 通过 Gemini API 在 AI Studio 等开发平台提供付费调用，入门价格为每百万输入 token 2 美元、输出 token 10 美元，缓存输入价格降低 95%。API 提供 100 万 token 的统一输入输出额度，可配合新的任务续接协议处理长任务。

Google states that after internal use of Argon, the number of agent-submitted code increased by over 35%, and code rollbacks decreased by nearly one-third; the model has helped the Chrome team refactor hundreds of files and has also been used to optimize the open-source ADK framework and quantum chemistry software. These results come from Google's own projects and evaluations. Google 称，内部使用 Argon 后，智能体提交代码的数量增加超过 35%，代码回滚减少近三分之一；模型曾帮助 Chrome 团队重构数百个文件，也被用于优化开源 ADK 框架和量子化学软件。这些结果来自 Google 自身的项目与评估。

For individual users, Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers can use Argon in the Gemini App and Search AI Mode; Ultra users can also use it in Antigravity. Google is also opening research applications, offering 6 months of the highest Antigravity usage tier to 10,000 selected scientists. 个人用户方面，Google AI Pro 和 Ultra 订阅者可在 Gemini App 与搜索 AI Mode 中使用 Argon；Ultra 用户还可在 Antigravity 中使用。Google 同时开放科研申请，将向经筛选的 1 万名科学家提供 6 个月 Antigravity 最高使用档位。

item.title: 字节跳动成立模型安全部门，负责人直接向吴永辉汇报
item.guid: 字节跳动成立模型安全部门，负责人直接向吴永辉汇报
item.description:
According to Caixin, ByteDance's AI model department, Seed, has internally announced the establishment of a "Seed Model – Alignment & Preparedness" department, specifically responsible for large model security risks. The new department will be led by Yan Lin, a core executive at Seed, and will report directly to Wu Yonghui, ByteDance's head of large models. 据财新报道，字节跳动 AI 模型部门 Seed 内部通知，将成立「Seed Model – Alignment & Preparedness」部门，专门负责大模型安全风险。新部门由 Seed 核心高管严林负责，直接向字节跳动大模型负责人吴永辉汇报。

Yan Lin has been responsible for the alignment direction of the Doubao large model in recent years. ByteDance told Caixin that the new department aims to strengthen investment in safety and alignment, enhance the safety capabilities of agent models, and prevent risks posed by cutting-edge capabilities such as chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear. 严林近年负责豆包大模型对齐方向。字节跳动向财新表示，新部门旨在加强安全与对齐投入，提升智能体模型的安全能力，并防范化学、生物、放射、核等前沿能力带来的风险。

The goal of model alignment is to make models follow human intentions under safety constraints. For chatbots like Doubao, this work also involves compliance of output content, quality of Q&A, and value expression. 模型对齐工作的目标，是让模型在安全约束下遵循人类意图。对于豆包等聊天机器人，这项工作也涉及输出内容合规、问答质量和价值观表现。

item.title: 华为称下一代麒麟芯片已就绪，9050 Pro GPU 性能提升 40%
item.guid: 华为称下一代麒麟芯片已就绪，9050-Pro-GPU-性能提升-40%
item.description:
Huawei held a Kirin media communication conference at Lianqiuhu, Shanghai, on October 13. Xu Songyu, Minister of Wireless Terminal Chip Product Management Department of Huawei's Semiconductor Business, for the first time unveiled the detailed architecture diagram of Kirin 9050 Pro and introduced its CPU, GPU, and image processing capabilities. 华为 10 月 13 日在上海练秋湖举行麒麟媒体沟通会。华为半导体业务无线终端芯片产品管理部部长徐松余首次公布麒麟 9050 Pro 的详细架构图，并介绍 CPU、GPU 和影像处理能力。

The Kirin 9050 Pro features a 9-core, 16-thread Lingxi CPU. Coupled with HarmonyOS application parallelization optimization, Huawei claims a 31% reduction in stuttering in typical scenarios. The Maliang GPU adopts a fourth-generation microarchitecture and second-generation ray tracing hardware acceleration, boosting performance by 40%, reducing power consumption by 45%, and improving ray tracing performance by 78%. 麒麟 9050 Pro 搭载 9 核 16 线程灵犀 CPU，配合鸿蒙应用并行化优化，华为称典型场景卡顿降低 31%。马良 GPU 采用第四代微架构及第二代光线追踪硬件加速，性能提升 40%、功耗降低 45%、光追性能提升 78%。

The imaging section uses a new generation AI ISP, supporting 200-megapixel fusion processing, with a 2x increase in pixel throughput; it also supports 18EV high dynamic range, real-time pixel-level skin tone segmentation, and BT.2020 color gamut. 影像部分采用新一代 AI ISP，支持 2 亿像素融合处理，像素吞吐率提升 2 倍；同时支持 18EV 高动态范围、实时像素级肤色分割及 BT.2020 色域。

Xu Songyu stated that the Kirin 9050 series has been mass-produced with the support of China's semiconductor industry, but the logic folding path still needs to address issues such as toolchains, process variation compensation, inter-layer interconnection overhead, and energy consumption, and called for cooperation between industry and academia. 徐松余表示，麒麟 9050 系列已在中国半导体产业界支持下量产，但逻辑折叠路径仍需解决工具链、工艺差异补偿、跨层互联开销和能耗等问题，并呼吁产业界与学术界合作。

Xu Songyu also revealed that the next generation of Kirin chips is ready, and all current test results meet expectations. He believes that logic folding technology can continue to evolve over the next 10 years, and the specific technologies to be adopted at each stage still need to be gradually discussed. 徐松余还透露，下一代麒麟芯片已准备就绪，目前所有测试结果均符合预期。他认为逻辑折叠技术未来 10 年可以持续演进，各阶段具体采用哪些技术仍需逐步讨论。

item.title: 首期 Apple 应用孵化器收官，Viba 获「加速先锋奖」
item.guid: 首期-Apple-应用孵化器收官，Viba-获「加速先锋奖」
item.description:
Yesterday, the first Apple App Accelerator held its final demo day in Beijing, with Tim Cook present to interact with the development teams. Compared to the mobile app innovation competition for students, the accelerator primarily supports teams that have completed product development and launched on the App Store, with courses covering technology, design, promotion, and business operations. 昨天，首期 Apple 应用孵化器在北京举行最终展示日，Tim Cook 到场与开发团队交流。与面向学生的移动应用创新赛相比，孵化器主要支持已经完成产品开发、上架 App Store 的团队，课程涵盖技术、设计、推广和商业运营。

AI fashion assistant Viba won this year's "Acceleration Pioneer Award". Users can upload street photos or social media screenshots, and the app identifies individual items, completes outfits, and displays the effect on a virtual avatar. During the project, the team further expanded from the US market to Mexico and Brazil, and clarified two revenue paths: merchant transaction commissions and user subscriptions. AI 穿搭助手 Viba 获得本届「加速先锋奖」。用户可上传街拍或社交平台截图，由应用识别单品、补全搭配，并在虚拟形象上显示效果。团队在项目期间从美国市场进一步拓展至墨西哥和巴西，并明确了商家交易抽成与用户订阅两种收入路径。

Another participating app, "Douya See", is designed for visually impaired users, supporting real-time video Q&A, ID photo shooting guidance, and book page reading. The team includes a totally blind engineer and a low-vision product manager. Mentors helped them improve narration, voice control, and Liquid Glass interface adaptation, allowing common functions to be completed without looking at the screen. 另一款参展应用「豆芽看见」面向视障用户，支持实时视频问答、证件拍摄引导和书页朗读。团队中有全盲工程师与低视力产品经理，导师帮助他们改善旁白、语音控制和 Liquid Glass 界面适配，让常用功能可在不看屏幕的情况下完成。

item.title: Visa 获批筹备中国境内银行卡清算机构
item.guid: Visa-获批筹备中国境内银行卡清算机构
item.description:
According to Xinhua News Agency, the People's Bank of China announced on October 13 that it has issued an administrative license decision to Visa Information Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd., approving its preparation for a bank card clearing institution. Visa Co., Ltd. is a foreign-invested enterprise established by Visa in China. 据新华社报道，中国人民银行 10 月 13 日公布，已向威士信息技术（北京）有限公司下发准予行政许可决定，批准其筹备银行卡清算机构。威士公司是 Visa 在中国境内设立的外商投资企业。

According to subsequent procedures, Visa Co., Ltd. needs to complete preparations within one year and then submit an application for operation. Only after the People's Bank of China, in conjunction with the National Financial Regulatory Administration, approves it, will a bank card clearing business license be issued. This approval corresponds to the preparatory stage. 按照后续程序，威士公司需在一年内完成筹备，再提交开业申请。中国人民银行会同金融监管总局审批同意后，才会颁发银行卡清算业务许可证。此次获批对应的是筹备阶段。

Visa stated on the same day that it will carry out follow-up work in accordance with the regulatory requirements of the People's Bank of China, striving to operate in the domestic market as soon as possible. Bank card clearing institutions are responsible for processing fund clearing and settlement in interbank card transactions. Visa 同日表示，将按照中国人民银行的监管规定开展后续工作，争取早日在国内展业。银行卡清算机构负责处理跨行银行卡交易中的资金清算和结算。

item.title: 英伟达中国 AI 芯片份额降至 34%，华为升至 28%
item.guid: 英伟达中国-AI-芯片份额降至-34%，华为升至-28%
item.description:
Reuters reported on October 13, citing an IDC report it saw, that Nvidia's share of China's data center AI chip market fell to 34% in the first half of 2026. Nvidia shipped 678,000 AI accelerators during the same period, a year-on-year decrease of 44%; Huawei shipped 572,000 units, with a 28% share. 路透社 10 月 13 日援引其看到的 IDC 报告称，2026 年上半年，英伟达在中国数据中心 AI 芯片市场的份额降至 34%。英伟达同期出货 67.8 万颗 AI 加速器，同比减少 44%；华为出货 57.2 万颗，份额为 28%。

China's total AI accelerator shipments reached 2.008 million units. Among them, GPU shipments were 991,000 units, a year-on-year decrease of 26%; other AI accelerator shipments increased by nearly 80%, reaching 1.016 million units, exceeding GPUs in quantity for the first time. These chips are mainly for specialized tasks such as running trained models. 中国 AI 加速器总出货量达到 200.8 万颗。其中 GPU 出货 99.1 万颗，同比下降 26%；其他 AI 加速器出货增长近 80%，达到 101.6 万颗，数量首次超过 GPU。这类芯片主要面向运行已训练模型等专用任务。

IDC linked this change to US export restrictions and Chinese companies adopting domestic alternatives. Huawei, T-Head, Kunlunxin, and Cambricon collectively account for 95% of the non-GPU market. The report believes that competition is shifting from single-chip performance to system capabilities, including the collaborative performance of chips in large computing clusters. IDC 将这一变化与美国出口限制、中国企业采用国产替代品联系起来。华为、平头哥、昆仑芯和寒武纪合计占非 GPU 市场的 95%。报告认为，竞争正从单颗芯片性能转向系统能力，包括芯片在大型计算集群中的协同表现。

item.title: AI 女团成员「怀孕」暂停活动，运营者称是为角色「减负」
item.guid: AI-女团成员「怀孕」暂停活动，运营者称是为角色「减负」
item.description:
The official account of AI virtual girl group BABYQUEEN announced from October 12 to 13 that member Mity (Kim Min-di) would suspend all group and individual activities due to "pregnancy," with her return date to be announced later. The official account subsequently released an apology letter in Mity's voice. AI 虚拟女团 BABYQUEEN 官方账号于 10 月 12 日至 13 日发布公告，称成员 Mity（金敏蒂）因「怀孕」暂停所有团体及个人活动，复出时间另行公告。官方随后还以 Mity 的口吻发布了道歉信。

BABYQUEEN is an AI digital girl group that has not yet officially debuted, consisting of 5 virtual members. The announcement's wording mimicked that of real idol hiatuses, and with the group name and stage name sounding similar to "AI," many netizens initially mistook it for news about a real artist, and the related topic subsequently trended on Weibo. BABYQUEEN 是尚未正式出道的 AI 数字女团，由 5 名虚拟成员组成。公告文案套用真人偶像停工的措辞，加上团名与艺名读音与「AI」相近，不少网友一度误以为是真实艺人的新闻，相关话题随后登上微博热搜。

The operator responded that "it's difficult for one person to manage" multiple AI characters simultaneously, hence this exit storyline was designed. 运营者回应称，同时运营多个 AI 角色「一个人难以负担」，因此设计了这一退场剧情。

item.title: Character.ai 申请破产保护，迪士尼拟以 2000 万美元竞购部分资产
item.guid: Character.ai-申请破产保护，迪士尼拟以-2000-万美元竞购部分资产
item.description:
Character.ai announced that it has initiated Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceedings in the Delaware court in the United States, intending to dispose of all or most of its assets through a court-supervised sale process, while continuing to operate its chat platform. Character.ai 宣布，已在美国特拉华州法院启动《破产法》第 11 章程序，拟通过法院监督的出售流程处置全部或大部分资产，期间继续运营聊天平台。

The company has reached a lead bidder agreement with Disney Worldwide Services, a subsidiary of Disney. Disney intends to pay $20 million to acquire a non-exclusive perpetual license for certain intellectual property and certain claims, with transitional services provided by former Character.ai employees hired by Disney. This offer will serve as the floor price for the auction and may still be superseded by higher or better offers. 公司已与迪士尼旗下 Disney Worldwide Services 达成首席竞标方协议。迪士尼拟支付 2000 万美元，取得部分知识产权的非独占永久许可及部分权利请求，并由其聘用的原 Character.ai 员工提供过渡服务。这项报价将作为拍卖底价，仍可能被更高或更优报价取代。

Character.ai expects the sale process and related transactions to be completed in late November or early December this year. The company stated it would minimize service disruptions; if no buyer ultimately continues to operate the platform, the platform's operations will gradually cease. Character.ai 预计，出售流程及相关交易将在今年 11 月下旬或 12 月初完成。公司称将尽量减少服务中断；如果最终没有买家继续运营平台，平台业务将逐步结束。

item.title: MiniMax 开设天猫旗舰店，M Plan 首单限时五折
item.guid: MiniMax-开设天猫旗舰店，M-Plan-首单限时五折
item.description:
According to Yicai, MiniMax officially launched on Tmall on October 13, opening its first brand official flagship store and listing large model subscription packages on the e-commerce platform. 据第一财经报道，MiniMax 于 10 月 13 日入驻天猫，开设首家品牌官方旗舰店，将大模型订阅套餐上架电商平台。

The store has listed three tiers of M Plan packages: Go, Explore, and Build, available for monthly or annual purchase. The activity interface shows that as of October 14, users can enjoy a limited-time 50% discount on their first order. 店铺已上架 M Plan 的 Go、Explore、Build 三档套餐，支持按月或按年购买。活动界面显示，截至 10 月 14 日，用户可享首单五折限时优惠。

Previously, Zhipu, Alibaba Cloud, Qianwen Office, and others had also opened stores on Tmall. Tmall also launched the Token Recharge Center "AI Space Station," consolidating subscription services from multiple large model vendors into a single entry point. 此前，智谱、阿里云、千问办公等也已在天猫开店。天猫还上线 Token 充值中心「AI 空间站」，把多家大模型厂商的订阅服务集中到同一入口。

item.title: 星尘智能完成 10 亿元融资，估值达 150 亿元
item.guid: 星尘智能完成-10-亿元融资，估值达-150-亿元
item.description:
On October 13, Stardust Intelligence announced the completion of a new round of financing totaling 1 billion yuan, bringing the company's valuation to 15 billion yuan. This round was led by Toukong Donghai (Shenzhen Investment Holdings), with participation from Hongtai Fund, Ninghai Xingtaihe Fund managed by Guanghua Sunshine, Shanheng Capital, and follow-on investment from existing shareholder Xianmu. 10 月 13 日，星尘智能宣布完成 10 亿元规模的新一轮融资，公司估值达 150 亿元。本轮由投控东海（深投控）领投，洪泰基金、光华阳光管理的宁海兴泰合基金、善恒资本等参与，老股东先沐追投。

The company stated that the funds will be used for model iteration, talent expansion, commercialization implementation, and capacity building, and will continue to invest in the full-stack architecture of "AI models, embodied operating systems, and rope-driven bodies." Its Lumo model is responsible for environmental understanding, reasoning, and action generation, Astribot OS organizes these capabilities into applications, and the rope-driven body performs actual operations. 公司表示，资金将用于模型迭代、人才扩充、商业化落地和产能建设，并继续投入「AI 模型、具身操作系统、绳驱本体」的全栈架构。其 Lumo 模型负责环境理解、推理和动作生成，Astribot OS 将这些能力组织为应用，绳驱本体承担实际操作。

In terms of commercialization, Stardust Intelligence stated that the S series has started receiving orders for thousands of units, and the new generation humanoid robot T1 will begin shipping in June this year. The combined production capacity of the S and T series will reach tens of thousands of units. The company's self-developed "Robot MART" retail service stores have been deployed in six cities including Beijing, Shanghai, and Guangzhou, while products for home and individual users are still under development. 商业化方面，星尘智能称 S 系列已开启千台级订单，新一代人形机器人 T1 今年 6 月开始发货，S 与 T 系列合计产能达到万台级。公司自研的「机器人 MART」零售服务店已在北京、上海、广州等六个城市部署，家庭和个人用户产品仍在研发中。

item.title: 曝阿里近百人开发千问办公电商版，计划双十一预售前发布
item.guid: 曝阿里近百人开发千问办公电商版，计划双十一预售前发布
item.description:
According to LatePost, Alibaba is organizing nearly a hundred people to develop the e-commerce version of Qianwen Office, planning to release it before the Double Eleven pre-sale. This product is aimed at multi-platform merchants and is the first industry version tested by Qianwen Office. 据《晚点 LatePost》报道，阿里正组织近百人开发千问办公电商版，计划在双十一预售前夕发布。该产品面向多平台商家，是千问办公测试的首个行业版本。

The project was prepared in June this year and entered intensive development in September, coordinated by Qianwen Office CEO Chen Yusen and led by Huang Pipei. The e-commerce team provides industry skills and merchant insights, while the Qianwen Office team provides general agent capabilities and product collaboration. 项目于今年 6 月筹备、9 月进入集中开发，由千问办公 CEO 陈宇森统筹，黄丕培负责。电商团队提供行业技能和商家洞察，千问办公团队提供通用 Agent 能力与产品协同。

The e-commerce version continues to use web and client entrances, allowing users to switch from the general version to 'E-commerce Operations,' which has an independent interface and product logic. It currently includes five sections: Double Eleven Special Zone, Operations Analysis, Product Management, Material Production, and Marketing Promotion. It can summarize store data, analyze reviews, and produce product materials, but it cannot directly adjust merchants' ad spending plans or manage ad placements, nor can it fully automate store management. 电商版沿用网页端和客户端入口，用户可从通用版切换到「电商经营」，拥有独立界面和产品逻辑。目前包括双十一专区、经营分析、商品管理、素材生产、营销推广五个板块，可汇总店铺数据、分析评价、生产商品素材，尚不能直接替商家调整投流计划或花钱投放，也不能全自动接管店铺。

The report states that about 20% of Qianwen Office's existing paid users are from the e-commerce industry. Taobao and Tmall data can be connected through Alibaba's internal system, and external platforms like Youzan and Keruyun are being integrated. Other platforms require merchants to authorize login before backend data can be collected. 报道称，千问办公现有付费用户中约 20% 来自电商行业。淘宝、天猫数据可通过阿里内部系统连接，有赞、客如云等外部平台正在接入，其他平台则需商家授权登录后采集后台数据。

item.title: Applied Intuition 获至少 300 亿美元估值投资邀约
item.guid: Applied-Intuition-获至少-300-亿美元估值投资邀约
item.description:
According to The Information, autonomous driving software company Applied Intuition has received multiple investment offers, corresponding to a valuation of at least $30 billion, double its valuation in June this year. Sources say these offers could prompt the company to raise at least $1 billion in the coming months. 据 The Information 报道，自动驾驶软件公司 Applied Intuition 已收到多份投资邀约，对应估值至少 300 亿美元，较今年 6 月翻倍。知情人士称，这些邀约可能促使公司在未来几个月募集至少 10 亿美元。

Applied Intuition was founded by former Y Combinator COO Qasar Younis and former Google Product Manager Peter Ludwig. It primarily sells software for developing, testing, and validating assisted driving and autonomous driving systems, as well as in-car operating systems, to automakers. Isuzu, Volkswagen, and Saudi Humain are among its clients. Applied Intuition 由前 Y Combinator COO Qasar Younis 和前 Google 产品经理 Peter Ludwig 创立，主要向车企出售用于开发、测试和验证辅助驾驶、自动驾驶系统的软件，以及车载操作系统。五十铃、大众和沙特 Humain 都是其客户。

This summer, the company launched Dana, an AI agent tool for automating the development of physical AI and software-defined vehicle systems. Last week, it also announced that it would provide vehicle operating systems and other technologies to Honda and Nissan, and is expanding its autonomous military vehicle business. 公司今年夏天推出 AI 智能体工具 Dana，用于自动化开发物理 AI 与软件定义车辆系统；上周又宣布为本田、日产提供车辆操作系统等技术，并在拓展自主军事车辆业务。

Applied Intuition has previously raised a total of $1.2 billion, with investors including a16z, General Catalyst, Lux Capital, and Kleiner Perkins. The new round is currently in the offer reception stage. Applied Intuition 此前累计融资 12 亿美元，投资者包括 a16z、General Catalyst、Lux Capital 和 Kleiner Perkins。新一轮目前处于收到邀约阶段。

item.title: AirTag 消音工具下架，可能帮助恶意跟踪
item.guid: AirTag-消音工具下架，可能帮助恶意跟踪
item.description:
According to MacRumors, accessory maker Elevation Lab sent a letter to customers on October 13, announcing the discontinuation of its AirTag silencing tool, Silencer. The company admitted that the product could help malicious individuals track targets who cannot receive phone notifications. 据 MacRumors 报道，配件厂商 Elevation Lab 10 月 13 日向客户发信，宣布停售 AirTag 消音工具 Silencer。公司承认，这款产品可能帮助有恶意的人跟踪无法收到手机通知的对象。

Silencer works by disabling the AirTag's speaker, preventing the tracker from emitting sound. The company initially stated that the product was designed for AirTags hidden on valuables like bicycles, to prevent sound alerts from notifying thieves. Silencer 通过破坏 AirTag 的扬声器，让追踪器无法发出声音。公司最初称，产品是为藏在自行车等贵重物品上的 AirTag 设计，避免声音提醒窃贼。

However, the sound an AirTag emits when it's away from its owner and potentially moving with a stranger is also a protective mechanism against unauthorized tracking. Glenn Fleishman, author for Six Colors, previously questioned whether the product would weaken this safeguard; the company's CEO responded at the time that even with the sound off, those being followed could still receive phone notifications. 但 AirTag 在远离主人、可能随陌生人移动时发出的声音，也是防止未经同意跟踪的保护机制。Six Colors 作者 Glenn Fleishman 此前质疑产品会削弱这项保障；公司 CEO 当时回应，即使关闭声音，被跟随者仍可能收到手机通知。

In its latest email, Elevation Lab withdrew the product and stated that it would use relevant patents to prevent other manufacturers from launching similar tools. Elevation Lab 在最新邮件中撤回了这一产品，并称将利用相关专利阻止其他厂商推出类似工具。

item.title: 曝腾讯启动约 50 亿美元发债，支持 AI 投资
item.guid: 曝腾讯启动约-50-亿美元发债，支持-AI-投资
item.description:
According to Bloomberg, Tencent began pitching dollar and offshore yuan bonds to investors on October 13. This issuance could raise approximately $5 billion, intended to support the company's continuously increasing AI investments. 据彭博社报道，腾讯于 10 月 13 日开始向投资者推介美元和离岸人民币债券，此次发行可能筹集约 50 亿美元，用于支持公司持续增加的 AI 投资。

A source revealed that the proposed dollar bonds are divided into 10-year and 20-year terms, with initial pricing guidance approximately 115 and 140 basis points higher than comparable U.S. Treasury bonds, respectively. Tencent also pitched 10-year and 30-year offshore yuan bonds. 一名知情人士透露，拟发行的美元债券分为 10 年期和 20 年期，初步定价指引分别较同期限美国国债高约 115 和 140 个基点。腾讯同时推介 10 年期及 30 年期离岸人民币债券。

item.title: 💡 Alexandr Wang：扎克伯格写得又快又严密，也对时间极其挑剔
item.guid: 💡-Alexandr-Wang：扎克伯格写得又快又严密，也对时间极其挑剔
item.description:
Meta's Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang recalled in an interview with David Senra that before joining Meta, he would occasionally consult Zuckerberg via WhatsApp and always received unexpectedly long replies. He used to wonder: how could someone with such a tight schedule have time to write so much? Meta 首席 AI 官 Alexandr Wang 在 David Senra 的采访中回忆，加入 Meta 前，他偶尔会通过 WhatsApp 向扎克伯格请教，总能收到出乎意料的长回复。他曾困惑：一个日程如此紧的人，怎么有空写这么多？

Later, he discovered that Zuckerberg wrote very quickly, and his long replies still maintained strict logic. This was a capability that deeply impressed him. Wang said that after being introduced to Zuckerberg, it took about a year for their first meeting to be scheduled; Zuckerberg dedicates a significant amount of time to the most important matters. 后来，他发现扎克伯格写作的速度很快，长回复仍保持严密的逻辑。这是令他印象深刻的一项能力。Wang 说，自己经人介绍认识扎克伯格后，第一次会面花了约一年才排进日程；扎克伯格会把大量时间留给最重要的事情。

To achieve all of this while also being a good father and partner, his only method is to prioritize extremely strictly.

Wang also recalled that the two originally planned to communicate every six months. After Llama 4 did not meet Meta's expectations, Zuckerberg proactively called him, asking what he should do and where to focus the AI strategy. For a founder who has long led a large company, his willingness to continuously seek advice from other entrepreneurs also deeply impressed Wang. Wang 也回忆，两人原本约每半年交流一次。Llama 4 未达到 Meta 的预期后，扎克伯格主动打电话，问他应该做什么、把 AI 战略的重点放在哪里。对一位已经长期执掌大公司的创始人，他仍愿意持续向其他创业者求教，这一点也让 Wang 印象深刻。

item.title: 3999 元，阶跃 STEPX Neo 智能体手机发布
item.guid: 3999-元，阶跃-STEPX-Neo-智能体手机发布
item.description:
Jieyue Terminal released its first intelligent agent phone, STEPX Neo Pioneer Edition, in Shanghai on October 13. It is equipped with the Step AOS 1.0 operating system and the personal intelligent agent 'Jieyue Amoo'. The full-stack price is 3999 yuan, including phone hardware, Step series models, the system, and the Step Studio development tools. 阶跃终端 10 月 13 日在上海发布首款智能体手机 STEPX Neo 先行版，搭载 Step AOS 1.0 操作系统和个人智能体「阶跃 Amoo」。全栈价为 3999 元，包含手机硬件、Step 系列模型、系统与 Step Studio 开发工具。

The phone uses a six-microphone array, a low-power audio sensing chip, and the Whisper 1.0 pickup algorithm to enhance speech recognition in complex environments; the back features an independent MiniLED dot matrix screen to display the agent's status. The system integrates long-term memory, task scheduling, and security mechanisms into its core, allowing users to view task processes, manage permissions, and memories. 手机采用六麦克风阵列、低功耗音频感知芯片和 Whisper 1.0 拾音算法，增强复杂环境下的语音识别；背面配有独立 MiniLED 点阵屏，用于显示智能体状态。系统将长期记忆、任务调度和安全机制融入底层，用户可查看任务过程、管理权限与记忆。

The on-device model handles simple tasks like adjusting settings and creating alarms, with some operations executable offline; complex queries and cross-application collaboration are planned by the cloud-side model and then executed on the device. The accompanying Step Studio supports generating AI Apps, games, agents, and Skills using natural language, and connects to external services via MCP and A2A. 端侧模型负责调节设置、创建闹钟等简单任务，部分操作可离线执行；复杂查询和跨应用协作由云侧模型规划，再交给端侧执行。配套 Step Studio 支持用自然语言生成 AI App、游戏、智能体及 Skill，并通过 MCP、A2A 连接外部服务。

The first batch of ecosystem partners includes products like Alipay, WorkBuddy, WeChat Work, WeChat Reading, and CapCut, which can invoke lifestyle services, office, and creative capabilities after user authorization. 首批生态合作涉及支付宝、WorkBuddy、企业微信、微信读书及剪映等产品，可在用户授权后调用生活服务、办公与创作能力。

The new phone is available in carbon black and silicon silver. Pre-sales begin on October 13th at 21:00, with official sales starting on October 16th at 10:13. 新机提供碳黑、硅银两色，10 月 13 日 21:00 开启预售，10 月 16 日 10:13 正式开售。

item.title: 比亚迪大汉上市，23.59 万元起、两驱续航 1008km
item.guid: 比亚迪大汉上市，23.59-万元起、两驱续航-1008km
item.description:
The BYD Dahang officially launched on October 13th, positioned as the flagship sedan of the Dynasty series. Three models were released: the 1008km RWD LiDAR Premium model for 235,900 yuan, the RWD Flagship model for 249,900 yuan, and the 880km 4WD LiDAR Flagship model for 275,900 yuan. 比亚迪大汉 10 月 13 日正式上市，定位王朝系列旗舰轿车，共推出三款车型：1008km 后驱激光雷达尊享型 23.59 万元、后驱旗舰型 24.99 万元，880km 四驱激光雷达旗舰型 27.59 万元。

The new car measures 5256 × 1999 × 1510mm (L×W×H) with a wheelbase of 3130mm, equipped with second-generation Blade Batteries and flash charging technology. The 102.3kWh battery provides a CLTC range of 1008km for the two-wheel-drive version and 880km for the four-wheel-drive version; the single-motor version has a maximum power of 370kW and accelerates from 0-100km/h in 4.9 seconds, while the dual-motor version has 570kW and accelerates in 3.3 seconds. 新车长宽高为 5256 × 1999 × 1510mm，轴距 3130mm，配备第二代刀片电池与闪充技术。102.3kWh 电池对应两驱版 CLTC 续航 1008km、四驱版 880km；单电机版最大功率 370kW，零百加速 4.9 秒，双电机版为 570kW、3.3 秒。

All models come standard with front dual zero-gravity seats, rear-wheel steering, and Yunlian-A dual-chamber air suspension, and support the Tian Shen Zhi Yan-B assisted driving system for urban navigation, highway navigation, and intelligent parking. The cabin is equipped with a 31-speaker Devialet sound system, rear screens and small tables, as well as a hot/cold box. 全系标配前排双零重力座椅、后轮转向和云辇-A 双腔空气悬架，并支持天神之眼-B 辅助驾驶的城区导航、高速导航与智能泊车。座舱配有 31 扬声器帝瓦雷音响、后排屏幕和小桌板，以及冷暖箱。

item.title: 千问发布 N1 系列 AI 眼镜与耳夹式耳机，补贴后 2218 元起
item.guid: 千问发布-N1-系列-AI-眼镜与耳夹式耳机，补贴后-2218-元起
item.description:
Qianwen launched and began selling three new products on October 13th: AI glasses N1, N1 Pro, and AI clip-on earphones, extending the capabilities of personal AI assistants, such as voice services and environmental perception, to wearable devices. After national subsidies and limited-time offers, the glasses start from 2218 yuan, and the earphones from 1099 yuan. 千问 10 月 13 日发布并开售 AI 眼镜 N1、N1 Pro 和 AI 耳夹式耳机三款新品，将个人 AI 助理的语音办事、环境感知等能力延伸至穿戴设备。叠加国补和限时优惠后，眼镜到手价 2218 元起，耳机 1099 元起。

    N1 Series Glasses: Equipped with a 50-megapixel imaging system and a 1G5P lens, supporting 4K video recording, anti-shake, Live Photos, as well as translation, meeting minutes, and voice services. A low-power sensing chip, combined with an on-device visual understanding model, can actively prompt environmental information such as station ticket gates and departure times after relevant functions are enabled.

    N1 Pro: Adds vital sign monitoring such as heart rate, blood oxygen, and skin temperature, as well as eye-tracking interaction and iris authentication. Users can look at specific menu content and ask for translation; Alipay's "Look to Pay" combines QR code scanning, payment confirmation, and a nod gesture to complete payments. The authentication capability was jointly developed by Qianwen and Ant Group's GPASS.

    AI Clip-on Earphones: Jointly launched by Qianwen and Bose, featuring an open-ear clip design, supporting real-time translation for 89 languages, multi-language transcription, and meeting minutes. Users can use voice commands to assign tasks like research reports and scheduled briefings, and receive reminders upon completion.

The three new products are now available for immediate purchase on platforms such as Taobao, Tmall, JD.com, and Douyin. 三款新品已在淘宝、天猫、京东、抖音等平台现货开售。

item.title: 曝《GTA 6》PC 版明年一季度推出
item.guid: 曝《GTA-6》PC-版明年一季度推出
item.description:
According to a GamesBeat report on October 13th, Rockstar plans to release the PC version of "GTA 6" in the first quarter of 2027. The report cites four industry insiders familiar with the studio's plans, who requested anonymity due to business relationships; the PC release date has not yet been officially announced by Rockstar. 据 GamesBeat 10 月 13 日报道，Rockstar 计划在 2027 年第一季度推出《GTA 6》PC 版。报道援引四位熟悉工作室计划的业内人士，他们因商业关系要求匿名；PC 版日期尚未经 Rockstar 正式公布。

Currently, the console version is scheduled to launch on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S on November 19th this year. If the aforementioned PC plan is implemented, the gap between the two will be shortened to a few months; "GTA 5" had a gap of about one year and seven months from its console launch in September 2013 to its PC release in April 2015. 目前，主机版定于今年 11 月 19 日登陆 PS5 和 Xbox Series X/S。若上述 PC 版计划落实，两者间隔将缩短到数月；《GTA 5》从 2013 年 9 月登陆主机到 2015 年 4 月推出 PC 版，间隔约一年七个月。

The report also mentioned that Rockstar acquired Cfx.re in 2023, the team that developed FiveM, a PC role-playing server framework for "GTA 5." The report indicates that Rockstar has released plans to include user creation tools in "GTA 6"; the official launch date for the online mode has not yet been announced. 报道也提到，Rockstar 在 2023 年收购了 Cfx.re，这支团队开发了《GTA 5》PC 角色扮演服务器框架 FiveM。报道指出，Rockstar 已释放在《GTA 6》中加入用户创作工具的计划；在线模式尚未公布正式上线日期。

Rockstar had previously delayed "GTA 6" twice, adjusting the original 2025 window to May 2026, and then extending it to November 19th; parent company Take-Two reiterated the existing console release schedule during this year's earnings call. Rockstar 此前已两次推迟《GTA 6》，将最初的 2025 年窗口调整到 2026 年 5 月，再延至 11 月 19 日；母公司 Take-Two 在今年财报电话会上重申了现有主机版档期。

item.title: 千问 Go 开放体验申请，可办理航班理赔和淘宝价保
item.guid: 千问-Go-开放体验申请，可办理航班理赔和淘宝价保
item.description:
Qianwen officially announced on October 13th that its personal AI assistant, "Qianwen Go!", is embedded within the Qianwen App, and the experience application page is now live. Users can join the waiting list, and the team is gradually opening up testing qualifications. 千问官方 10 月 13 日宣布，个人 AI 助理「千问 Go！」内嵌于千问 App，体验申请页已上线。用户可加入等待名单，团队正逐步开放测试资格。

According to press releases and test user sharing, Qianwen Go can query orders from user-authorized platforms, compare solutions, and communicate with service providers. In a flight delay case, where the user had forgotten the specific flight, Qianwen Go queried the order and flight status, contacted customer service to confirm the delay, then changed the voucher solution proposed by customer service to cash compensation, ultimately securing 70 yuan. 据新闻稿及测试用户分享，千问 Go 可查询用户授权平台的订单、比较方案，并与服务方沟通。在一则航班延误案例中，用户已忘记具体航班，千问 Go 查询订单和航班动态，联系客服确认延误，再将客服提出的代金券方案改为现金赔付，最终争取到 70 元。

In another instance, a user knew that Taobao's price protection allowed refunds but was unsure how to proceed. Qianwen Go accessed the Taobao price protection page, checked orders, found a qualifying wok order, and applied for a refund of the 52 yuan difference. 另一例中，用户知道淘宝价保可以退款，却不清楚操作方式，千问 Go 进入淘宝价保页面检查订单，找到符合条件的炒锅订单并申请退回 52 元差价。

The first batch of scenarios also includes calling Tuhu for price inquiries and booking car maintenance, reserving badminton courts by time slot, and comparing the cost of replacing a refrigerator by factoring in subsidies, coupons, old appliance recycling, and delivery/installation fees. These tasks, building on Qianwen's previous integration with services like Taobao, Alipay, Fliggy, and Amap, further extend to personal matters requiring repeated inquiries, filtering, and communication. 首批场景还包括致电途虎询价、预约汽车保养，按时段预订羽毛球场，以及综合补贴、优惠券、旧机回收和送装费用比较冰箱换新成本。这些任务在千问此前接入淘宝、支付宝、飞猪和高德等服务的基础上，进一步扩展到需要反复查询、筛选和沟通的个人事务。

item.title: 消息称腾讯正开发「元宝助手」独立 App
item.guid: 消息称腾讯正开发「元宝助手」独立-App
item.description:
According to "Du Jia" citing informed sources, Tencent Yuanbao is developing a personal intelligent agent "Yuanbao Assistant," planning to use a standalone app to carry long-cycle tasks and personal long-term memory, giving it independent operating space and permissions from the main Yuanbao app. 据《读佳》援引知情人士报道，腾讯元宝正在开发个人智能体「元宝助手」，计划以独立 App 承载长周期任务和个人长期记忆，给予它独立于元宝主 App 的运行空间与权限。

The "Product Notes" article further states that the product is still under development, created by the Hunyuan team, focusing on automated execution and long-term follow-up of personal affairs; the existing Yuanbao will continue to provide general Q&A and task processing. 「产品笔记」文章进一步称，该产品仍在研发中，由混元团队打造，侧重自动执行和长期跟进个人事务；现有元宝则继续提供通用问答和任务处理。

"Du Jia" also learned that multiple business departments within Tencent are developing personal intelligent agent-related products or features, including the social business department. 《读佳》还获悉，腾讯内部多个业务部门正在研发个人智能体相关产品或功能，其中包括社交业务部门。

item.title: 面壁智能发布 MiniCPM-V 4.7，35B 模型约 3GB 内存即可运行
item.guid: 面壁智能发布-MiniCPM-V-4.7，35B-模型约-3GB-内存即可运行
item.description:
Minibox AI released its edge-side multimodal model MiniCPM-V 4.7, offering two versions: 35B-A3B and 1B. The 35B-A3B uses an MoE architecture with a total of 35 billion parameters, activating only about 3 billion parameters per inference, supporting image, multi-image, document, and video understanding. 面壁智能发布端侧多模态模型 MiniCPM-V 4.7，提供 35B-A3B 与 1B 两个版本。35B-A3B 采用 MoE 架构，总参数为 350 亿，每次推理仅激活约 30 亿参数，支持图像、多图、文档与视频理解。

Minibox states that with the "Look-ahead Expert Scheduling" (LES) technology, 35B-A3B can run with approximately 3GB of memory. Tests on the iPhone 17 Pro Max, as published in the official open-source repository, show a decoding speed exceeding 13 tokens per second; actual tests on the iPad Pro in the press release exceeded 15 tokens per second. 面壁称，借助「前瞻专家调度」LES 技术，35B-A3B 可在约 3GB 内存下运行。官方开源仓库公布的 iPhone 17 Pro Max 测试解码速度超过每秒 13 个 token；新闻稿中的 iPad Pro 实测则超过每秒 15 个 token。

LES predicts the experts to be called in the next layer in advance, pre-reading corresponding weights from storage devices while current computations are ongoing, allowing loading and computation to overlap and reduce waiting times. The project also open-sources edge-side adaptation and inference code, supporting systems like iOS, Android, and HarmonyOS; the 1B version is for edge devices with more limited resources. LES 会提前预测下一层需要调用的专家，在当前计算进行时从存储设备预读对应权重，让加载与计算重叠，减少等待。项目同时开放端侧适配与推理代码，支持 iOS、Android 和鸿蒙等系统；1B 版本面向资源更有限的端侧设备。

item.title: 《燕云十六声》计划 11 月支持 DLSS 5
item.guid: 《燕云十六声》计划-11-月支持-DLSS-5
item.description:
The official "Where Winds Meet" team announced that the game is expected to officially support NVIDIA DLSS 5 in November, with early access opening simultaneously. The team states that this title will be the first domestic game and currently the only NetEase game to officially support this technology. 《燕云十六声》官方宣布，游戏预计于 11 月正式支持 NVIDIA DLSS 5，并同步开放抢先体验。团队称，该作将成为国内首款、目前网易唯一一款正式支持这项技术的游戏。

The development team stated that this integration involved multiple rounds of deep customization and optimization with NVIDIA, hoping to improve material, lighting, and overall visual performance in large-scale scenes; the official team also released a demo video showcasing the adjusted game scenes. 开发团队表示，此次接入经过与英伟达的多轮深度定制和调优，希望改善大规模场景中的材质、光影与整体画面表现；官方同时发布了演示视频，展示调整后的游戏场景。

item.title: 拓竹官宣首款 3D 扫描仪 S1，11 月开售
item.guid: 拓竹官宣首款-3D-扫描仪-S1，11-月开售
item.description:
Bambu Lab announced that its first 3D scanner, the S1, will go on sale in November this year. The official community has simultaneously released a product appearance preview, marking Bambu Lab's first entry into the 3D scanning category. 拓竹科技宣布，旗下首款 3D 扫描仪 S1 将于今年 11 月开售。官方社区已同步发布产品外观预告，这是拓竹首次进入 3D 扫描品类。

The official preview image shows the S1 adopting a handheld form factor with a grip and multiple optical windows on the front. The poster describes the product with "Easy in Hand. Pro in Every Scan.," emphasizing handheld operation and professional scanning capabilities. 官方预告图显示，S1 采用带握柄的手持形态，正面配有多个光学窗口。海报以「Easy in Hand. Pro in Every Scan.」描述产品，强调手持操作与专业扫描定位。

The S1 extends its product line from 3D printing, laser cutting, and UV printing to physical object digitalization: 3D scanning captures the form of real objects and generates digital models, forming a connected manufacturing process with 3D printing, which produces physical objects from models. S1 将其产品线从 3D 打印、激光切割和 UV 打印延伸至实物数字化：3D 扫描采集现实物体的形态、生成数字模型，与将模型制作成实物的 3D 打印形成前后相接的制造环节。

item.title: 三星展示新一代 AI 内存与存储，联合 AMD 演示 CXL 扩容
item.guid: 三星展示新一代-AI-内存与存储，联合-AMD-演示-CXL-扩容
item.description:
Samsung showcased memory and storage solutions for AI infrastructure at OCP Global Summit 2026, covering high-bandwidth memory, CXL memory expansion, and inference cache storage, and jointly validated CXL expanded memory capacity and bandwidth solutions with AMD. 三星在 OCP Global Summit 2026 展示面向 AI 基础设施的内存与存储方案，覆盖高带宽内存、CXL 内存扩展和推理缓存存储，并与 AMD 联合验证 CXL 扩展内存容量、带宽的方案。

The official display page introduces that a CMM-D-based memory pool can flexibly allocate memory among multiple large model instances. In Samsung's demonstration tests, compared to static allocation, the first token waiting time was reduced by up to 38%, and effective throughput was increased by up to 3.3 times; these results are from specific test workloads. 官方展示页介绍，基于 CMM-D 的内存池可在多个大模型实例间弹性分配内存。在三星的演示测试中，相比静态分配，首个 token 等待时间最多降低 38%，有效吞吐量最高提升至 3.3 倍；这些结果来自特定测试负载。

Samsung also showcased LPDDR5X-PIM with in-memory computing: by adding computing units to memory, data movement is reduced. Tests on its edge accelerator with Llama 3.1 8B showed inference speeds up to 3 times faster than traditional LPDDR5X solutions. 三星还展示了存算一体 LPDDR5X-PIM：通过在内存中加入计算单元，减少数据搬运。其端侧加速器上的 Llama 3.1 8B 测试，推理速度最高达到传统 LPDDR5X 方案的 3 倍。

This exhibition also included HBM4E, SOCAMM2, PCIe 6.0 enterprise SSD PM1763, and 256TB QLC SSD BM1773. For KV caching in AI inference, Samsung demonstrated hardware and software optimization combined with LMCache to reduce write amplification and host CPU overhead. 此次展品也包括 HBM4E、SOCAMM2、PCIe 6.0 企业级 SSD PM1763，以及 256TB QLC SSD BM1773。针对 AI 推理的 KV 缓存，三星展示了结合 LMCache 的软硬件优化，降低写放大和主机 CPU 开销。

item.title: 爱芯元智发布 AX8860，单芯提供 256 TOPS 原生 FP4 算力
item.guid: 爱芯元智发布-AX8860，单芯提供-256-TOPS-原生-FP4-算力
item.description:
Aixin Yuanzhi released the AX8860 series AI chips at the China International Industry Fair on October 13, targeting edge and client-side deployment of large models, and simultaneously launched the Yuanxi A256S module, inference card, and inference server. 爱芯元智 10 月 13 日在中国国际工业博览会发布 AX8860 系列 AI 芯片，面向大模型的边缘与端侧部署，并同步推出元曦 A256S 模组、推理卡和推理服务器。

The company introduced that the chip uses a 6nm process, features a 16-core Arm Cortex-A55 CPU and a self-developed NPU, providing 256 TOPS of native FP4 computing power without relying on sparsity computation; it supports up to 128GB LPDDR5X memory with a bandwidth of 273GB/s, and supports PCIe 5.0 interconnection. 公司介绍，芯片采用 6nm 制程，搭载 16 核 Arm Cortex-A55 CPU 和自研 NPU，提供 256 TOPS 原生 FP4 算力，不依赖稀疏性计算；最高支持 128GB LPDDR5X 内存，带宽达 273GB/s，并支持 PCIe 5.0 互联。

Complementary products include a dedicated module with a rated power consumption of 40W, a single-slot PCIe card, and a quad-core solution. The chip supports multi-core cascading, and the company claims that four cores can achieve 1024 TOPS with an expansion efficiency of approximately 80%. 配套产品包含额定功耗 40W 的专用模组、单槽 PCIe 卡，以及四芯方案。芯片支持多芯级联，公司宣称四芯可达 1024 TOPS，扩展效率约 80%。

At the software level, AX8860 supports inference frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang, and PyTorch, provides ONNX and Hugging Face model support, is compatible with OpenAI API service interfaces, and comes with a complete toolchain for quantization, conversion, compilation, and debugging. Mini PCs and pocket PCs based on this chip are also in planning. 软件层面，AX8860 支持 vLLM、SGLang、PyTorch 等推理框架，提供 ONNX、Hugging Face 模型支持，兼容 OpenAI API 服务接口，并配套量化、转换、编译和调试工具链。基于该芯片的 Mini PC 和口袋 PC 也在规划中。

item.title: 「79 岁老干妈陶华碧用 AI 一年赚 54 亿」冲上热搜，营收创新高
item.guid: 「79-岁老干妈陶华碧用-AI-一年赚-54-亿」冲上热搜，营收创新高
item.description:
Jiemian News reported on October 13 that Li Xin, Executive Vice President and Chief Quality Officer of Laoganma, disclosed at the Guizhou Province Quality Development Conference that the company's revenue will reach 5.4 billion yuan in 2025, setting a new historical peak. In the same year, the factory's AI visual quality inspection system will be fully launched across all workshops. 界面新闻 10 月 13 日报道，老干妈常务副总、首席质量官李鑫在贵州省质量发展大会上披露，公司 2025 年营收达到 54 亿元，创历史最高峰值。同年，工厂的 AI 视觉质检系统实现全车间上线。

This system is mainly used for screening chili raw materials: high-speed industrial cameras continuously scan chilies on the conveyor belt, identifying spoiled fruits such as mold and black spots, and then removing them with an airflow device. Li Xin stated that after the system was implemented, the defect rate of products in key processes dropped to 0.02%, and core raw materials achieved 100% traceability. 这套系统主要用于筛选辣椒原料：高速工业相机持续扫描传送带上的辣椒，识别霉变、黑斑等坏果，再通过气流装置剔除。李鑫称，系统落地后，关键工序产品不良率降至 0.02%，核心原料实现 100% 可追溯。

Laoganma remains low-key in brand marketing. Jiemian News observed that its official account's last post was in March 2022, and its official Douyin flagship store has not live-streamed for nearly a year; the company disbanded its live-streaming team around 2022, refocusing on offline distribution channels. 老干妈在品牌营销端仍保持低调。界面新闻观察到，其公众号最后一篇推文停留在 2022 年 3 月，抖音官方旗舰店近一年未直播；公司在 2022 年前后解散直播团队，重新聚焦线下经销渠道。

The 5.4 billion yuan that sparked heated discussion this time is the company's annual revenue. Li Xin described the performance as the result of four years of quality consolidation and system optimization, not attributing it entirely to AI quality inspection. 这次引发热议的 54 亿元是公司全年营收。李鑫将业绩表述为四年来质量巩固与体系优化的结果，没有将其全部归因于 AI 质检。

item.title: Beats 推出宝可梦联名款音箱
item.guid: Beats-推出宝可梦联名款音箱
item.description:
Beats announced on October 13 its collaboration with The Pokémon Company International to launch a special edition Beats Pill Bluetooth speaker, inspired by Pikachu and Mimikyu, priced at 1299 yuan, available from October 15 through Apple's official website and the official Beats flagship store on Douyin. Beats 10 月 13 日宣布与宝可梦国际公司合作推出特别版 Beats Pill 蓝牙音箱，以皮卡丘和谜拟丘为设计灵感，售价 1299 元，10 月 15 日起通过苹果官网和抖音 Beats 官方旗舰店发售。

The co-branded speaker grille features two Pokémon, and the body combines Pikachu's electric yellow with Mimikyu's grayscale tones. This is also the first time Beats has equipped the Pill with charms, including a Poké Ball, the Beats「b」logo, and a lightning bolt pattern, and it comes in special edition packaging. 联名款网罩印有两只宝可梦，机身结合皮卡丘的电光黄与谜拟丘的灰度色调。这也是 Beats 首次为 Pill 配备挂饰，包含精灵球、Beats「b」标志和闪电图案，并采用特别版包装。

The audio capabilities continue the Beats Pill's custom acoustic system, supporting high-resolution lossless audio playback via USB-C, and allowing two units to be wirelessly paired for amplifier or stereo mode. It offers up to 24 hours of battery life, boasts IP67 dust and water resistance, comes with a detachable lanyard, and can charge compatible phones via USB-C. 音频能力延续 Beats Pill 的定制声学系统，支持通过 USB-C 播放高分辨率无损音频，也可将两台无线配对为功放模式或立体声模式。续航最长 24 小时，具备 IP67 防尘抗水能力，随附可拆卸挂绳，并可通过 USB-C 为兼容手机充电。

item.title: Golden Goose 推出迪士尼联名，并启动全球门店定制巡回
item.guid: Golden-Goose-推出迪士尼联名，并启动全球门店定制巡回
item.description:
According to Variety, Golden Goose's Mickey & Friends collection, a collaboration with Disney, launched on October 13, covering sneakers, apparel, and accessories, and will feature in-store customization events at select global locations. 据 Variety 报道，Golden Goose 与迪士尼合作的 Mickey & Friends 系列于 10 月 13 日推出，覆盖运动鞋、服装及配饰，并将在全球部分门店开展现场定制活动。

The collection centers around the Super-Star sneaker, featuring gray suede, white leather star, and Mickey Mouse graphics, available in adult and children's sizes. Apparel includes reversible bomber jackets, hoodies, T-shirts, and hats, along with themed patches, badges, charms, and shoelaces, which can be further customized through the brand's Co-Creation service. 系列以 Super-Star 鞋款为核心，采用灰色麂皮、白色皮革星标和米老鼠图案，提供成人与儿童尺码。服装包括可双面穿的飞行员夹克、卫衣、T 恤和帽款，另有主题布贴、徽章、挂饰及鞋带，可通过品牌的 Co-Creation 服务进一步定制。

The tour begins on October 14 at the South Coast Plaza store in California, then travels to cities including New York, Milan, Paris, London, Shanghai, and Tokyo, continuing until early December. Disney character artists will collaborate with brand artisans to draw character designs, and stores will also feature Mickey Mouse ears, comic coloring, and keychain making activities. 巡回从 10 月 14 日的加州 South Coast Plaza 门店开始，随后前往纽约、米兰、巴黎、伦敦、上海、东京等城市，持续至 12 月初。迪士尼角色艺术家将与品牌工匠一起绘制角色图案，店内还设有米老鼠耳朵、漫画上色及钥匙扣制作活动。

item.title: 葛韦格版《纳尼亚传奇》首曝预告，明年 2 月登陆影院
item.guid: 葛韦格版《纳尼亚传奇》首曝预告，明年-2-月登陆影院
item.description:
Greta Gerwig's "The Chronicles of Narnia: The Magician's Nephew" released its first trailer on October 13. Netflix held a presentation at the AMC Lincoln Square IMAX theater in New York, with the film set to premiere on February 12, 2027, and then launch on Netflix on April 2 after a 49-day theatrical window. 格蕾塔·葛韦格执导的《纳尼亚传奇：魔法师的外甥》10 月 13 日发布首支预告。Netflix 在纽约 AMC Lincoln Square 的 IMAX 影厅举行展示，影片定于 2027 年 2 月 12 日上映，经过 49 天影院窗口后，于 4 月 2 日上线 Netflix。

The new film is an adaptation of C. S. Lewis's "The Magician's Nephew," telling the adventure of children entering Narnia with the help of magic rings. David McKenna and Beatrice Campbell play the two young protagonists, Daniel Craig stars as Uncle Andrew; Emma Mackey, Carey Mulligan, and Meryl Streep also join the cast. 新片改编自 C. S. 刘易斯的《魔法师的外甥》，讲述孩子们借助魔法戒指进入纳尼亚的冒险。David McKenna 和 Beatrice Campbell 饰演两位小主角，丹尼尔·克雷格出演 Andrew 舅舅；艾玛·麦基、凯瑞·穆里根与梅丽尔·斯特里普等也加盟。

The trailer's soundtrack features Led Zeppelin's "Stairway to Heaven." Gerwig said in a live Q&A with Stephen Colbert that she obtained permission to use the song after showing the film to Robert Plant and Jimmy Page. 预告配乐使用了齐柏林飞艇的《Stairway to Heaven》。葛韦格在与斯蒂芬·科尔伯特的现场问答中说，她向 Robert Plant 和 Jimmy Page 展示电影后，获得了使用这首歌的许可。

Mark Ronson and Andrew Wyatt, who previously composed music for "Barbie," are once again responsible for the score. Gerwig stated that the two began working during pre-production and would also play some of the music to the actors during filming. 曾为《芭比》创作音乐的 Mark Ronson 和 Andrew Wyatt 再度负责配乐。葛韦格表示，两人在前期筹备就开始工作，拍摄期间也会将部分音乐播放给演员。

item.title: Netflix 拿下 2030 世界杯西班牙与安道尔独家版权
item.guid: Netflix-拿下-2030-世界杯西班牙与安道尔独家版权
item.description:
Netflix announced on October 13 that it has acquired exclusive broadcasting rights for the 2030 FIFA World Cup in Spain and Andorra, and will live-stream all 104 matches. Netflix 10 月 13 日宣布，获得 2030 年 FIFA 世界杯在西班牙和安道尔的独家转播权，将直播全部 104 场比赛。

This edition of the tournament is the World Cup Centenary edition, co-hosted by Spain, Portugal, and Morocco, with Argentina, Paraguay, and Uruguay also hosting centenary commemorative matches. Netflix will produce pre-match, halftime, and post-match shows, as well as daily matchday highlights, covering the entire tournament. 该届赛事是世界杯百年纪念版，由西班牙、葡萄牙和摩洛哥联合主办，阿根廷、巴拉圭和乌拉圭另承办百年纪念比赛。Netflix 将制作赛前、中场和赛后节目，以及比赛日每日集锦，覆盖完整赛事。

The exclusive rights also include free-to-air television arrangements: Spanish viewers can watch one match for free each matchday. Netflix will also provide a tournament package to a national free-to-air broadcaster, including all matches of the Spanish team, two semi-finals, and the final, with specific cooperation arrangements to be announced later. 独家权利也包含免费电视播出安排：西班牙观众每个比赛日可免费观看一场比赛。Netflix 还将向一家全国性免费电视台提供赛事包，包含西班牙队全部比赛、两场半决赛和决赛，具体合作安排稍后公布。

Netflix and FIFA have previously collaborated on World Cup documentaries and have also acquired broadcasting rights for the 2027 and 2031 Women's World Cups in the United States and Canada. Netflix 与 FIFA 此前已合作制作世界杯纪录片，也获得了 2027 年和 2031 年女足世界杯在美国、加拿大的转播权。

item.title: 《杀死伊芙》同宇宙新剧《Honey》完成戛纳首映
item.guid: 《杀死伊芙》同宇宙新剧《Honey》完成戛纳首映
item.description:
The new series "Honey," set in the same story universe as "Killing Eve," had its global premiere at Cannes MIPCOM and secured pre-sales from platforms like Australia's Stan and New Zealand's Sky. Deadline, in an on-site interview, introduced the series, produced by BBC and Germany's ZDF, as a blend of spy thriller, romance, and dark comedy. 与《杀死伊芙》处于同一故事宇宙的新剧《Honey》，在戛纳 MIPCOM 完成全球首映，并获得澳大利亚 Stan、新西兰 Sky 等平台的预购。Deadline 在现场采访中介绍，这部由 BBC 与德国 ZDF 制作的剧集，将间谍惊悚、爱情和黑色喜剧结合起来。

The story is set in East Berlin in 1982, with Ann Skelly playing undercover agent Martha. She navigates counter-espionage operations and becomes entangled in a love triangle. This character later appears as Carolyn Martens in "Killing Eve," played by Fiona Shaw; the production team emphasizes that "Honey" uses the same story universe but does not define it as a prequel. 故事发生在 1982 年的东柏林，Ann Skelly 饰演潜伏特工 Martha。她在反间谍行动中周旋，也被卷入一段三角关系。该角色后来以 Carolyn Martens 的身份出现在《杀死伊芙》中，由 Fiona Shaw 饰演；制作团队强调，《Honey》沿用同一故事宇宙，但不将其定义为前传。

The new series also features Nate Mann, Jannis Niewöhner, and Rory Kinnear. Screenwriter Emma Moran said she wanted to combine the spy genre with a love story: characters live in a social environment where they must restrain desires and conceal identities, yet emotions constantly break through these restrictions. 新剧还有 Nate Mann、Jannis Niewöhner 和 Rory Kinnear 参演。编剧 Emma Moran 说，她希望把间谍类型与爱情故事碰撞在一起：人物生活在必须约束欲望、隐瞒身份的社会环境中，情感却不断冲破这些限制。
